title: SDLC Task-Qualified Reference v1
description: A reference to an addressable entity in another task identified by TaskIdentifier. Legacy entity selectors and explicit intent/result JSON-path-like selectors are accepted during migration.
$comment: Canonical task-local selectors use #intent/<collection>/<id> or #result/<collection>/<id>. Legacy #result/<id> and other unrooted selectors remain recognized only for migration compatibility until the task-local migration task completes.

oneOf.description: A task-qualified reference with an explicit intent/result JSON-path-like selector.
A legacy task-qualified reference retained for migration compatibility.
